title: Ethiopian Red Lentil Stew (Misir Wot)
description: A classic Ethiopian dish made with red lentils, onions, garlic, and spices. It's a comforting and flavorful stew that's perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the misir (red lentil spice blend) and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the misir wot hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (optional).
Serve with injera bread or over rice, if desired.
